items.title: Germany news: Emergency at Leipzig airport sparked by novice driver
items.excerpt: Two men breached a fence at the Leipzig/Halle airport while practicing for a driving test. Meanwhile, the "Invest in Germany Summit" is set to kick off as the government looks to fill gaps in public funding. DW has more.
